question: What twofold yoga teaching has been heard according to divine and hero distinctions?
premises: The teaching is distinguished by divine and hero grades
A pair of yogas is mentioned
The speaker has heard this pair
inference: The speaker has heard a pair of yogas distinguished by the divine and hero grades
uncertainties: The paśu grade is not explicitly named in this verse
plain_english: By the distinction of divine and hero, a pair of yogas has been heard by me.
